subject.title: Anthropic replay fails with "Invalid signature in thinking block" for thinking-enabled sessions after tool loops (no compaction)

question: Should this issue be closed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 as scoped, or should it stay open until the Fable5 completed-turn poisoning reported on v2026.6.11 is handled here or in a canonical follow-up?
rationale: The linked PR is a plausible fix for non-Fable current-turn replay scoping, but it intentionally preserves the Fable5 replay contract while the latest issue comment reports the same user-visible failure on Fable5.

options.title: Keep open for Fable5 scope
options.body: Keep this issue open after the linked PR until maintainers decide whether Fable5 completed-turn thinking should be stripped, retried through recovery, or tracked by a narrower canonical issue.

options.title: Close after linked PR only
options.body: Treat the linked PR as the full fix for this issue and route Fable5 poisoning to an existing recovery issue such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92201 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/94228.

recommendation.title: Keep open for Fable5 scope
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open after the linked PR until maintainers decide whether Fable5 completed-turn thinking should be stripped, retried through recovery, or tracked by a narrower canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is tied to Fable5/adaptive-thinking replay contract ownership, where recent history points most strongly to steipete.
